## Summary

- add the provider-neutral ACP subprocess/stdin-stdout transport on top of the official `agent-client-protocol` Rust SDK
- negotiate stable ACP v1 capabilities and support explicit new/load/resume, prompt, cancel, updates, permission transport, EOF/protocol/process failure handling, and shutdown
- expose the session-open and negotiated-session interfaces needed by the later AgentHost bridge while keeping completion semantics in AgentHost

## Scope

No Codex, Claude, Goose, AI Studio UI, GameEngine MCP tool-content, work-claim, validation, or completion-policy implementation is included.

## Validation

This is a parallel authoring subtask. Heavy cargo, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are intentionally deferred to the final integration chat. Canonical producer/request preflight remains required.
